'''Sela''' is the bedchamber maid to Lord [[Gareth Bryne]] at his estate in [[Kore Springs]] in [[Andor]].

==Activities==
When [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]], and [[Elmindreda Farshaw|Min Farshaw]] are sentenced to service to Lord Bryne, [[Caralin]] hopes to replace the aging Sela with Leane since she is still trying to find a wife for him.{{ref/book|5|1}}
